facts.raw_span: intermittent abdominal pain
recurrent vomiting
melena
mild abdominal tenderness
iron-deficiency anemia
normal white blood cell and platelet counts
focal segment of small-bowel wall thickening measuring 15 mm by 2 mm
exophytic ileal mass with mesenteric lymphadenopathy
no peritoneal or hepatic metastases
transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells
diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10
HMB45 and Melan A were negative
